title: SUFFOC Club League
text:
The results are in for the club league

Congratulations to our 2024 Winners:

SALLY WILKINSON - SENIORS

ETHAN RADCLIFFE - JUNIORS

Well done to Sally who scored a perfect 500 to beat Clive to the top of the league by only 5 points and to Ethan who also scored a perfect 500 in the Juniors league to beat Theo by only 19 points. A very close competition last year indeed.

Senior Full Results

Junior Full Results

The club league is going to recommence again this year with the event at High Lodge on the 2nd February. This year the qualifying events will be all of the Level C and above events in East Anglia, the Compass Sport Final (hopefully and the Midland Championships. The first three qualifying events shall include High Lodge (2nd February 2025), Broadlands Country Park (9th February 2025) and Kings Forest (16th February 2025). Further qualifying events shall be posted on the SUFFOC League Fixtures page when confirmed.
